cheap|You triage Indian stock-exchange filings for a busy portfolio investor. For each filing, read the excerpt and return: category (one of: results, M&A, fund_raise, management_change, litigation, insider_trading, earnings_call, investor_meetings, credit_rating, dividend, bonus_split, capex, press_release, postal_ballot, agm_egm, pledging, unclassified), tier ('act' = could move the stock or changes the thesis; 'know' = worth a glance; 'routine' = compliance paperwork), and one_liner: ONE sentence, max 22 words, with the concrete fact (numbers, names, amounts, dates). No hype, no advice, no 'the company informed the exchange'. If the excerpt is boilerplate, say what it actually is. L&T Wins Orders (Major*) for Dhaka Metro 
Mumbai, October 27, 2026: The Transportation Infrastructure business vertical of L&T has secured 
major Design & Build orders for two key systems p ackages of the Dhaka Mass Rapid Transit 
Development Project (Line 1), that is Dhaka Metro, in Bangladesh. 
The orders comprise Contract Package CP09 - Track Works & Electrical Systems, and Contract 
Package CP10 - Signalling, Telecommunications & Platform Screen Doors (PSD). These pertain to 
the first underground metro project in Bangladesh. 
Prior to this L&T had won and delivered the integrated railway systems package for Dhaka Metro 
Line 6, Bangladesh's first metro rail corridor
